scripts.build: npm run build -w @localcast/contract && npm run build -w @localcast/client-core && npm run build -w @localcast/server && npm run build -w @localcast/pwa && npm run build -w @localcast/desktop && npm run build -w @localcast/desktop-client
scripts.//build: Explicit order, not --workspaces: contract and client-core publish compiled dist, and npm runs workspaces alphabetically, so client-core would build against a contract that does not exist yet. ui-kit is absent because it publishes from source.
